friction.detail: Sandbox reports STARTED but every execution attempt fails with ConnectionResetError: "Failed to execute command: ('Connection aborted.', ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer'))"

Running daytona create --help unexpectedly starts local servers and crashes with port already in use instead of printing help: "Error occurred error=\"listen tcp :22222: bind: address already in use\""

The sandbox image shipped an outdated SDK (0.134.0) that had to be manually upgraded to match the current API: "Requirement already satisfied: daytona in /usr/local/lib/python3.14/site-packages (0.134.0)"
No guidance that the sandbox proxy is unreachable immediately after STARTED, forcing custom retry loops that still fail: "Attempt 5 failed... All attempts failed"
Connection failures surface as deep urllib3/ssl.py tracebacks rather than a clear sandbox-not-ready message: "File \"/usr/local/lib/python3.14/ssl.py\", line 1076, in _create self.do_handshake()"
